annotations.title: utilpeek: extract keyphrases from a text (RAKE)

description: utilpeek: Extract the keywords and keyphrases of a text. For raw frequencies use text_frequency; for names and places use extract_entities. Returns the top keyphrases of a text by RAKE (phrases between stop words and punctuation, scored by word degree / frequency), with score and count. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/keyword-extraction-api.html

language.description: Stop-word language: de, en (default), es, fr, it, nl or pt.
language.title: Language

top_n.description: Keyphrases to return, best first (1-100, default 10).
top_n.title: Top N

name: text_keywords

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
